- #602 C-45 STAT MNAM: `schema/fallout4/fields.json` STAT gained four `kind: string` rows on MNAM, `STAT\DistantLodLevel0` (offset 0, `minimum_payload_size` 260), `DistantLodLevel1` (260, 520), `DistantLodLevel2` (520, 780) and `DistantLodLevel3` (780, 1040), all `existing_only`. xEdit `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:12083` declares `wbStruct(MNAM, 'Distant LOD', [wbStringForward('Level 0', 260), 'Level 1', 'Level 2', 'Level 3'])`, so each level is a NUL-terminated mesh path inside its own fixed 260-byte slot and the payload floor for level N is the end of that slot. `src/environment/base_records.cpp:decode_static_distant_lod` already read the same slots on the typed path (a size that is not a multiple of 260, or a slot with no terminator inside its 260 bytes, fails closed there); the schema rows give the generic path the same four values. STAT authoring already lists MNAM at 0 to 1, so no authoring row changed.
- #602 C-45 slot strings: `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:scalar_field_bytes` and `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:scalar_slot_bytes` returned the whole payload for every zstring row. They now branch on `descriptor.embedded`: a whole-payload string row keeps the old behavior, and a slotted row returns `payload.subspan(offset)` cut after its first NUL, so `schema::decode_scalar` still sees exactly one NUL-terminated string and its non-embedded check is unchanged. The new helper is `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:slot_string_bytes`, which searches only the slot that ends at the row's `minimum_payload_size` (the tail of the payload when the row has no floor) before it throws `ScalarError` for a slot with no NUL terminator, the same refusal the typed decoder makes; searching to the payload end instead would let a slot without a terminator read the bytes of the next slot. `minimum_payload_size` gates a level the same way it gates EXPL DATA members, so a one-slot 260-byte MNAM exposes level 0 only. Every reader of a row goes through those two functions, so the generic field cell in `PluginEditTool/native/src/plugin/RadiclePluginFields.cpp:semanticFieldCells` decodes the levels too (it maps a `ScalarError` to `<opaque>`) and `src/schema/preflight.cpp:preflight_record` reports a slot without a terminator as `invalid_scalar_storage`.
- #602 C-45 write refusal: `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:write_scalar` replaces the whole subrecord payload for a string row (`data = encoded`), which would drop the other three slots and the unused bytes of the edited one, so it now throws `ScalarError` for a row with `scalar.embedded` before the slot is resolved. MNAM is read-only through the generic rows, as FSTS XCNT is; `fo4::set_record_scalar` on a slotted string row fails earlier with the wrong-setter refusal. The PluginEditTool caller turns either into `ScalarFieldWriteFailed`.
- #602 C-45 codegen: `Radicle/tools/schema_codegen.py` dropped `offset` and `minimum_payload_size` from `STRING_FORBIDDEN` (they were rejected on string rows) and now reads `WIDTHS.get(storage, 0)` for the two payload-size checks, because a string row's storage is `zstring` and has no entry in `WIDTHS`. `Radicle/tools/field_address_codegen.py:reject_overlaps` treated every embedded row with no width as whole-payload, which would have reported four slotted string rows at different offsets as overlapping; the new `Radicle/tools/field_address_codegen.py:field_span` gives a zero-width embedded row the span from its offset to its `minimum_payload_size`, or to the payload end (`payload_size`, else unbounded) when the row has no floor, so the slot ranges are compared exactly and the diagnostic stays the byte-range one. `payload_size` and `stride` stay forbidden on string rows. Unit tests: `Radicle/tools/test_localized_row_codegen.py` gained `test_slotted_string_rows_carry_their_offset` and `test_slots_must_not_share_a_subrecord_range`; `Radicle/tools/test_field_address_codegen.py` now expects the offset and payload-size refusals a string row does make.
- #602 C-45 tests: `Radicle/tests/test_stat_lod_rows.cpp` (`StatLodRows`) covers the four row shapes (`RowsUseTheXEditForwardStringLayout`), two decoded slots and the two levels a 520-byte payload hides (`ReadsEachSlotUpToItsTerminator`), a one-slot payload exposing only level 0 plus a 259-byte payload exposing none (`OneSlotExposesOnlyTheFirstLevel`), the negative case of a slot whose 260 bytes hold no NUL (`ASlotWithoutATerminatorFailsClosed`, on both `scalar_field_bytes` and `decode_scalar`) and the generic-write refusal with a byte-identical reread (`RefusesGenericWritesAndKeepsTheBytes`). `Radicle/docs/FO4_PARITY.md` was regenerated; STAT's string column moved from 1 to 5.
- #602 B-20 IMAD interpolators: `schema/fallout4/fields.json` IMAD gained two uncounted array rows, `IMAD\TintColorInterpolators` (`TNAM`) and `IMAD\FadeColorInterpolators` (`NAM3`), stride 20, `existing_only`, with the five f32 members Time, Red, Green, Blue and Alpha. xEdit declares `wbArray(TNAM, 'Tint Color', wbColorInterpolator).SetRequired` at source:xEdit Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:7530 and the same for `NAM3` at `:7531` @93cc0bc5, and `wbColorInterpolator` is `wbStructSK([0], 'Data', [wbFloat('Time'), wbFloatRGBA('Value')])` at source:xEdit Core/wbDefinitionsCommon.pas:8199 @93cc0bc5, so one element is 4 + 16 bytes and `wbFloatRGBA` stores Red, Green, Blue, Alpha in that order (`wbDefinitionsCommon.pas:6874-6896`). The rows cannot be named after the xEdit field: `IMAD\TintColor` and `IMAD\FadeColor` are already the DNAM `u32` rows at offsets 176 and 236, and `tools/schema_codegen.py:load_schema` rejects a duplicate path.
- #602 B-20 IMAD size: the two IMAD DNAM rows hold the same names as the arrays, so the member paths take the array name as a prefix (`IMAD\TintColorTime`, `IMAD\TintColorRed`, ...), matching the element naming already used by `CLMT\WeatherChance` and `LVLI\FilterChance`. The arrays are uncounted, like every other `PRPS`, `WLST` and `LLKC` row, so `src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:scalar_slots` derives the element count from the payload size and a payload that is not a whole number of 20-byte elements throws `schema::CountedArrayError`, and `src/schema/scalar.cpp:scalar_descriptor` returns nothing for `TNAM` and `NAM3`, which is unchanged: `TNAM` already had 28 scalar rows and no caller depends on the signature-only lookup.
- #602 B-20 tests: `Radicle/tests/test_image_fx_records.cpp` (`ImageFxSynthetic`) gained `InterpolatorMembersEditOneStrideElement`, whose fixture adds a 2-element `TNAM` and a 1-element `NAM3` to IMAD record 3001. It checks the element counts (2 for the `TNAM` member, 1 for the `NAM3` member, 0 on IMAD 3002, which has no `TNAM`), three decoded values including the last member of the stride, the rewrite of element 1 of `TNAM` and element 0 of `NAM3` against the real bytes at offsets 20 and 0 after a write and reread, that element 0 of `TNAM` is untouched, and the two negative cases where an index at the count and a record without the subrecord return `subrecord_missing`. `Radicle/docs/FO4_PARITY.md` was regenerated: IMAD moves from 64 to 74 scalar rows and the array column from blank to 10.
- `Radicle/src/plugin/flags.cpp:set_plugin_localized_flag` (with `Radicle/include/fo4/plugin/writer.hpp:set_plugin_localized_flag` and the export `Radicle/src/c_api.cpp:radicle_plugin_set_localized_flag`) sets TES4 flag bit 7 on both `Plugin::tes4.header.flags` and `Plugin::header.tes4_flags` and clears the cached original bytes through `Radicle/src/plugin/flags.cpp:clear_tes4_original_bytes`, the same shape as `Radicle/src/plugin/flags.cpp:set_plugin_master_flag`. xEdit has no extra guard either: `Core/wbImplementation.pas:6307` (`TwbFile.SetIsLocalized`) only refuses files that are not plugins and files that are not editable, then assigns the flag. Flipping the flag reinterprets every localized-capable subrecord as a 4-byte string id (`Radicle/src/schema/localized_fields.cpp:is_localized_field`, `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:171`), so it is the caller's job to only set it on files whose strings are already stored that way; Radicle adds no string-table migration, matching xEdit.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_tes4_header_setters.cpp` (`Tes4Header.LocalizedFlagSetClearAndIndependentOfMaster`, `Tes4HeaderCApi.SetsLocalizedFlagThroughTheHandle`). Coverage: set, idempotent re-set, master flag stays set beside it, TES4 flags survive a write/re-read, clear, and the cleared state survives another round trip. Not compiled in this lane (no C++ builds).
- D-9 preservation verified: `Radicle/tests/test_tes4_header_setters.cpp:KeepsTnamScrnOfstAndDeleAcrossTextSetters` writes a TES4 carrying OFST, DELE, SCRN, TNAM, INTV and INCC, runs `Radicle/src/plugin/flags.cpp:set_plugin_author` and `Radicle/src/plugin/flags.cpp:set_plugin_description`, and asserts the four ignored subrecords come back byte-identical with the full subrecord order HEDR, OFST, DELE, CNAM, SNAM, MAST, DATA, SCRN, TNAM, INTV, INCC. Two writer paths make that hold: `Radicle/src/plugin/writer.cpp:replace_master_subrecords` only replaces MAST and DATA and keeps every other subrecord in place, and `Radicle/src/plugin/flags.cpp:precedes_tes4_text` inserts CNAM and SNAM after HEDR, OFST and DELE and before MAST. xEdit agrees that OFST and DELE are ignored byte arrays (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:12100-12101`), and it reads SCRN and TNAM as a screenshot blob and a transient-type array (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:12115-12125`); `Radicle/src/plugin/tes4.cpp:parse_tes4_header` reads none of the four, so they stay preserved-only, not decoded. Not compiled in this lane (no C++ builds).
- WRLD OFST and CLSZ stay preserved-only, with no `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json` row: `Core/wbDefinitionsCommon.pas:9680-9700` (`wbWorldCellSizeData`) and `:9944-9960` (`wbWorldOffsetData`) define both as a row array of `wbArray('Cell', wbInteger(itU32))` whose column count comes from `Core/wbDefinitionsCommon.pas:1783` (`wbWorldColumnsCounter`), derived from `WRLD\BoundsMinX` and `WRLD\BoundsMaxX` plus the WLEV level size, and whose row count has a matching `wbWorldRowsCounter`. Both are `cpIgnore` and `wbNeverShow`, and CLSZ is `dfNoCopyAsOverride`, so xEdit itself never shows or copies them; a two-dimensional counted array has no kind in `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json` today (only `scalar`, `string`, `counted_array`, `subrecord_group`), so modelling it is a new schema kind rather than a row. The authoring side already knows them as single optional subrecords with no default (`Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json` WRLD rules for OFST and CLSZ, `Radicle/tools/record_schema_codegen.py:render`), so they can never be added by `Radicle/src/plugin/subrecord_authoring.cpp:add_with_rules` and `Radicle/src/plugin/writer.cpp` keeps their bytes untouched.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_wrld_rows.cpp` (`WRLDRows.OffsetAndCellSizeBlobsArePreservedButNotAuthored`). Coverage: OFST is 8 bytes and CLSZ 16 in the fixture, both report `already_present` from `Radicle/src/plugin/subrecord_authoring.cpp:add_record_subrecord`, a `WLEV` LevelWidth write through `Radicle/src/plugin/mutation.cpp:set_record_scalar` reaches the bytes and both blobs survive the write and re-read unchanged, and the negative control is the same add on a WRLD without OFST, which reports `no_default`. Not compiled in this lane (no C++ builds).
## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE DATA form links (#602 C-25)

- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE DATA` gains ten FormLink rows over the same `DATA` subrecord the scalar rows use: `RACE\SeverableExplosion` (146), `RACE\SeverableDebris` (150), `RACE\SeverableImpactDataSet` (154), `RACE\ExplodableExplosion` (158), `RACE\ExplodableDebris` (162), `RACE\ExplodableImpactDataSet` (166), `RACE\OnCrippleExplosion` (176), `RACE\OnCrippleDebris` (180), `RACE\OnCrippleImpactDataSet` (184) and `RACE\ExplodableSubsegmentExplosion` (188). xEdit: a wb form-ID-check call for `Severable - Explosion` with targets `EXPL` and `NULL` .. a `wbFromVersion(118, ...)` call of the same shape for `Explodable - Subsegment Explosion`, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:11176-11190`, which `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE` mirrors. Every row is `nullable: true` (xEdit lists NULL as a target) and `insertion: existing_only`.
- `Radicle/src/schema/formlink_slots.cpp:formlink_field_at` and `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_schema.cpp:schema_formlink_offsets` gate on the record form version; `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:formlink_slots` applies the same gate to the write path. Rows are gated `min_form_version: 124` and `payload_sizes: [200]`.
- The 124 gate is the same one the scalar rows use, and for the same reason: `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_records.cpp:race_data_offsets` computes `severable = (version >= 109 ? 32 : 8) + (version >= 124 ? 114 : 110)`, so the six Severable/Explodable links sit at 146-166 only from form version 124; at 109-123 they sit at 142-162 and the OnCripple triple moves from 172-180 to 176-184. Below 124 the rows resolve to no slot and the writer returns `subrecord_missing` rather than touching the older offsets. Pre-109 and 109-123 layouts are not rowed, matching `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE DATA` scalars.
- No double counting. `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_schema.cpp:struct_or_mixed_handler_owns` makes the struct handler win: `race_data_offsets` already returns these ten offsets, so `schema_formlink_offsets` skips the whole `DATA` subrecord and `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:visit_formlink_offsets` never sees the rows. The rows add the one thing the struct handler cannot: target validation in `Radicle/src/graph/check_errors.cpp:slot_targets`, which asks `formlink_field_at` first and previously got `nullopt` for RACE `DATA`.
- `FormLinkFieldDescriptor::min_form_version` is new (`Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:FormLinkFieldDescriptor`), emitted by `Radicle/tools/formlink_schema_codegen.py` after `max_form_version`; a row with no `max_form_version` still emits the positional `0, <min>` pair. No existing row has `min_form_version`, so only the RACE rows changed in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/generated_formlink_lists.inc` apart from target-pool index renumbering.
- `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:formlink_slots` only runs its `payload_sizes` guard when the record's form version admits the field. Without that, a 196-byte `DATA` at form version 123 threw `FormLinkFieldError("has unexpected payload size")` for a row whose gate already hides it; the field now resolves to nothing and the writer returns `subrecord_missing`, which is what the scalar rows do.
- Overlap: `Radicle/src/forms/race.cpp:decode_race` reads and `create_race` writes the same offsets; `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE DATA` authors no default for the links (all `existing_only`). The typed `fo4::forms::Race` struct is unchanged and still has no member for the debris, explosion or impact data links.
- Corpus: the ten offsets are the values `race_data_offsets` reports for the 110 master RACE `DATA` subrecords, which are all 200 bytes at form version 131 (see `Radicle/docs/code-notes/Radicle.md` entry `RACE DATA`). No master record was read to confirm the target types on those slots; the target lists come from xEdit.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_race_data_links.cpp:RaceDataLinks` covers row offsets, targets, nullability, gates and payload size; the offsets being claimed exactly once by `collect_form_links`; the rows being hidden and the writer refusing at form versions 109 and 123; a write and reread of all ten links plus a NULL write; and a 196-byte `DATA` at form version 131 throwing.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE link rows (#602 C-26)

- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE` gains two of the three single-link subrecords that had no row. The third, `RACE\CollarTextureSet` (`NAM2`, target `TXST`, `payload_sizes: [4]`), was drafted and then dropped as not expressible for RACE at this point; xEdit models it as a wb form-ID-check call over `NAM2` with target `TXST`, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:11245`. The marker bullet below gives the reason. It gained a `repeated: true` row without a declared payload size in the RACE movement data overrides section below, which drops the `payload_sizes: [4]` shape this draft had.
- `RACE\MovementType` (`MTYP`, `MOVT`) and `RACE\EquipSlot` (`QNAM`, `EQUP`) are `repeated: true` with `payload_sizes: [4]`. xEdit models both in `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE` as `wbRArrayS('Movement Data Overrides', wbRStructSK([0], 'Override', [wb form-ID-check call on `MTYP` with target `MOVT`, wbSPED]))` (:11250-11251) and `wbRArray('Equip Slots', wbEquipSlot)` where `wbEquipSlot` is `wbRStruct('Equip Slot', [wb form-ID-check call on `QNAM` with target `EQUP`, wbString(ZNAM, 'Node')])` (:11030-11038). Radicle addresses one link per occurrence, so the `MTYP`/`SPED` and `QNAM`/`ZNAM` pairing is not modelled: the row edits the i-th `MTYP` or `QNAM` subrecord and never touches the `SPED` payload or the `ZNAM` node that sits next to it. Editing the paired `SPED` movement data is the `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:MOVT SPED` surface, unchanged here.
- `RACE\EquipSlotNodes` (`ZNAM`, `kind: string`, `repeated: true`) is the `wbString(ZNAM, 'Node')` half of the same struct, the counterpart of the existing `RACE\BipedObjectNames` (`NAME`) row. `ZNAM` stays in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/non_formid_slots.inc` (`{"RACE","ZNAM"}`, `// xEdit`) and in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/unclaimed_link_allowlist.inc`: the row reads the bytes as a zstring, it does not claim the subrecord as a FormLink.
- The rows add target validation and editing, not collection: `MTYP`, `NAM2` and `QNAM` are already in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formid_subrecords.inc`, so `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:collect_form_links` found those subrecords before this change too, and the `sig == k_qnam` early-out in `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:visit_link_offsets` belongs to the WTHR branch only, not to RACE. What the rows add is that `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_schema.cpp:schema_formlink_offsets` now reports their offsets, so `remap_record_form_links` and `Radicle/src/graph/check_errors.cpp:slot_targets` (which now gets the `MOVT` and `EQUP` target lists) cover them. Verified against `Radicle/tests/test_form_link_schema_remap.cpp:SchemaOffsetsCoverGeneratedRowsOutsideOwnedBranches`, which iterates every generated row: `MTYP` and `QNAM` have no struct or mixed handler for RACE, so the test requires the offset to be reported and it is.
- Why `RACE\CollarTextureSet` was left unrowed at this point (the RACE movement data overrides section below supersedes this by rowing it `repeated: true`): RACE reuses `NAM2` three times in xEdit, for `wbEmpty(NAM2, 'Marker NAM2 #1')` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:11201`), `wbEmpty(NAM2, 'Marker NAM2 #2')` (:11226) and the collar itself (:11245). `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` sets `duplicate` as soon as a non-repeated row's subrecord appears more than once in the record, before payload sizes are considered, so a `RACE\CollarTextureSet` row resolves on no real RACE record and the writer throws. Position-based disambiguation is not expressible in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/field_address.hpp:FieldAddress`, which offers only a repeated stride and a value discriminator. `RACE\MovementType` and `RACE\EquipSlot` are unaffected: they are `repeated: true`, and the `MTYP`/`QNAM` markers xEdit pairs with them are per-occurrence, not extra signature collisions.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_race_link_rows.cpp:RaceLinkRows` covers the row subrecords, targets, offsets and shapes; the signatures being collected as FormLinks (`MTYP` twice, `QNAM` once); a write and reread of the first equip slot and the second movement type; the `ZNAM` node strings through `fo4::set_record_string`, including an out-of-range index; and the refusal of a local `ARMO` target where `MOVT` is required, with the link left unmodified.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE morph and subgraph rows (#602 C-27)

- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE` gains the morph group rows of xEdit `wbMorphGroups` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:3130`, used for male at :11280 and female at :11298). `RACE\MorphGroupNames` (`MPGN`, `kind: string`, `repeated: true`) is `wbString(MPGN, 'Name')` (:3135); `RACE\MorphGroupMask` (`MPPK`, whole-payload `u16`, `presentation: enum`, `repeated: true`) carries the 15 `wbEnum` names of :3145-3163 (male 1171-1177, female 1221-1227, `None` 65535) verbatim; `RACE\MorphPresetIndices` (`MPPI`, `u32`, repeated, :3139), `RACE\MorphPresetMorphs` (`MPPM`, string, repeated, :3141), `RACE\MorphPresetPlayable` (`MPPF`, `u8`, `enum` False/True, maximum 1, repeated, `wbBoolEnum` at :3143) and `RACE\MorphPresetTexture` (`MPPT` link to `TXST` offset 0, `payload_sizes: [4]`, repeated, not nullable, :3142) are the nested `wbRArray('Morph Presets', wbRStruct('Morph Preset', ...))` half of the same struct, so every one of them is a repeated subrecord rather than a struct member.
- `MPPN` (`wbLString(MPPN, 'Name', 0, cpTranslate)`, :3140) needs no scalar row: it is already in `localized_subrecords`, next to `FMRN` (`wbLString(FMRN, 'Name')`, :3176), the name half of `wbFaceMorphs` (:3170, used at :11281 and :11299). `MPGS` (`wbArray(MPGS, 'Morph Group Sliders', ...)`, :3165) is deliberately left without a row: it is one variable-length subrecord holding N `u32` indices, and every Radicle scalar row is whole-payload of exactly one storage width, so a row here would reject legitimate two-element payloads; an element-array row is needed first. `MPPC` (:3137) is the benign group count and has no row.
- `RACE\FaceMorphIndices` (`FMRI`, `u32`, repeated), `RACE\MorphValueIndices` (`MSID`, `u32`, repeated), `RACE\MorphValueMinNames` (`MSM0`, string, repeated) and `RACE\MorphValueMaxNames` (`MSM1`, string, repeated) follow `wbFaceMorphs` and `wbRArray('Morph Values', wbRStruct('Value', [wbInteger(MSID, 'Index', itU32), wbString(MSM0, 'Min Name'), wbString(MSM1, 'Max Name')]))` (:11332-11337). `RACE\MorphLastIndex` (`MLSI`, whole-payload `u32`, not repeated) is the flat `wbInteger(MLSI, 'Morph Last Index', itU32, wbIntToHexStr, wbHexStrToInt)` at :11339, so it is the only row in this group that fails closed with `subrecord_missing` on a record without the subrecord.
- `RACE\SubgraphBehaviorGraphs` (`SGNM`, string, repeated) and `RACE\SubgraphAnimationPaths` (`SAPT`, string, repeated) are the string members of `wbRArray('Subgraph Data', wbRStruct('Data', ...))` (:11306-11327) at :11309 and :11310. The sibling `SAKD`/`STKD` keyword links already have rows; the `SRAF` flags struct of :11316-11326 gained its own two rows in `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE`, described in the next section. `MPPT` was already listed in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formid_subrecords.inc`; the new row is what gives it slots, so nothing was removed from `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/unclaimed_link_allowlist.inc`.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_race_link_rows.cpp:RaceMorphRows` asserts the subrecord, storage, repeated flag and enum names of every new row against the xEdit source above, then reads a synthetic RACE carrying `FMRI`, `MSID`, `MPPK`, `MPPF`, `MPGN`, `SAPT` and `MPPT`, rewrites five of them plus the `MPPT` link, and rereads the raw bytes. Negative cases: `RACE\MorphLastIndex` on a record without `MLSI` returns `subrecord_missing`, an unknown mask name resolves to nothing, and `65536` on the `u16` mask throws `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:encode_scalar`'s `ScalarError`.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE subgraph flags rows (#602 C-27)

- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE` gains `RACE\SubgraphRole` and `RACE\SubgraphPerspective`, the two `u16` members of `wbStruct(SRAF, 'Flags', [wbInteger('Role', itU16, wbEnum([{0} 'MT', {1} 'Weapon', {2} 'Furniture', {3} 'Idle', {4} 'Pipboy'])), wbInteger('Perspective', itU16, wbEnum(['3rd', '1st']))])`, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:11313-11326`, used at :11312 inside `wbRArray('Subgraph Data', wbRStruct('Data', ...))` (:11306). Both rows are `subrecord: SRAF`, `offset` 0 and 2, `storage: u16`, `presentation: enum`, `payload_size: 4`, `repeated: true` and `insertion: existing_only`, so every SRAF occurrence -- one per Subgraph Data entry -- exposes both halves instead of one whole-payload row that would refuse every legitimate 4-byte payload. The shape is the FURN `FNPR` precedent, `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN`, which the same two-`u16`-in-4-bytes problem already uses; the file also carries xEdit's `dfTerminator` on that struct, which is a display flag for the enclosing array and not a payload layout, so it changes nothing here.
- `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` gives an embedded field a slot only while the payload is exactly `payload_size` bytes, so a truncated `SRAF` exposes no slot and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:write_scalar` returns `ScalarMutationStatus::subrecord_missing` instead of writing past the payload. `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:scalar_slot_bytes` then hands `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:decode_scalar` only the two bytes of the addressed member, which is why the rows can share one subrecord.
- `MPGS` (`wbArray(MPGS, 'Morph Group Sliders', wbInteger('Index', itU32, ...))`, :3165) had no row at this point: it is one variable-length subrecord holding N `u32` indices and no Radicle scalar row addresses an element array, so a row here would reject every legitimate two-element payload. It gained one in a later lane: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE\MorphGroupSliders` is a `u32` row with `offset` 0 and `stride` 4, the LVLI `LLKC` element shape, so `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` yields one slot per index instead of rejecting the payload (the RACE morph sliders section below). `RACE` `SPCT` (:11062) stays unrowed as well: it is the `SetCountPath` count of the `SPLO` array (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:3285`) and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:write_scalar` refuses a row on a counted-array count subrecord by design.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_race_link_rows.cpp:RaceMorphRows.RowsMatchXEditSubrecordsStorageAndNames` asserts both rows' subrecord, `u16` storage, enum presentation, embedded offset 0 and 2, `payload_size` 4, repeated address and the name lookups (`Pipboy` 4, `1st` 1, with `Rifle` and `2nd` unresolved). `Radicle/tests/test_race_link_rows.cpp:RaceMorphRows.WritesMorphAndSubgraphValuesInPlace` reads a synthetic RACE carrying two `SRAF` payloads, rewrites the role of the second and the perspective of the first, and rereads `SRAF` 0 as `(1, 1)` and `SRAF` 1 as `(3, 1)`. Negative cases: index 2 returns `ScalarMutationStatus::subrecord_missing`, perspective 2 throws `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:encode_scalar`'s `ScalarError`, and `Radicle/tests/test_race_link_rows.cpp:RaceMorphRows.RejectASubgraphFlagsPayloadOfTheWrongWidth` shows a 2-byte `SRAF` yields no slot (`record_field_count` 0, write `subrecord_missing`, bytes untouched).
- Corpus: none read here -- the official masters are not reachable from this worktree, so `CheckErrors.VanillaMasterHasNoErrorFindings` and the parity matrix are what a wrong `payload_size` would trip in CI.
- Parity: `Radicle/tools/parity_matrix.py:main` regenerated `Radicle/docs/FO4_PARITY.md` (RACE 46 to 48 scalar rows).

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE\SpellCount (#602 C-27)

- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE\SpellCount` is the last C-27 subrecord that had no row: `SPCT`, whole-payload `u32`, 4 bytes, `insertion: existing_only`. xEdit declares it as `wbSPCT := wbInteger(SPCT, 'Count', itU32, nil, cpBenign)` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:3283`) and pairs it with the actor-effect list through `wbSPLOs := wbRArrayS('Actor Effects', wbSPLO).SetCountPath(SPCT)` (:3285); RACE carries both at :11062-11063. The shape is `NPC_\SpellCount` (`Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_`, same subrecord and storage) so the two records now read the counter the same way.
- Measured over the seven official masters (read-only scan): 110 RACE records, 91 of them carrying a 4-byte `SPCT` (56 hold 1, 35 hold 2), 19 carrying neither `SPCT` nor `SPLO`. In all 91 the value equals the number of `SPLO` subrecords on the record, 0 mismatches, so the row reads the shipped counts and the count agrees with the list it counts. Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_race_data_rows.cpp:RaceDataRows.SpellCountRowReadsAndWritesTheSpctSubrecord` (row shape; read 2; write 3 and reread the `SPCT` bytes with `DATA` untouched; a record without `SPCT` returns `subrecord_missing` and keeps its bytes) and `Radicle/tests/test_typed_families_real.cpp:TypedFamiliesRealData.RaceSpellCountAgreesWithTheActorEffectList` (the 110/91/56/35 totals and the per-record agreement above).
- Not guarded against stale counts: writing `SPCT` does not resize `SPLO`, so a caller that sets 3 on a record with two effects leaves a counter that disagrees with the list. The same hazard exists for `NPC_\SpellCount` and `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:LENS\SpriteTotal`; #602 D-26 is the row that would make element arrays and their counters move together. Unverified: that the engine tolerates a mismatched count at runtime.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE FaceGen, idle chatter and wrinkle map rows (#602 C-26 C-27)

- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE` gains four whole-payload `f32` rows and one repeated string row from the flat subrecords xEdit lists between the head data and the attack race, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:11207-11208` and `:11330-11331`: `RACE\FaceGenMainClamp` (`PNAM`, 'FaceGen - Main clamp'), `RACE\FaceGenFaceClamp` (`UNAM`, 'FaceGen - Face clamp'), `RACE\IdleChatterTimeMin` (`PTOP`) and `RACE\IdleChatterTimeMax` (`NTOP`). All four are `insertion: existing_only` with no offset and no `payload_size`, so `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` takes the whole-payload branch and a payload that is not exactly four bytes is `malformed` rather than addressed -- `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:scalar_slots` then raises `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:ScalarError` and nothing is written.
- `RACE\WrinkleMapPath` (`WMAP`, string, repeated) covers the two wrinkle map paths xEdit writes as `wbString(WMAP, 'Male Wrinkle Map Path')` and `wbString(WMAP, 'Female Wrinkle Map Path')`, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:11282` and `:11300`, which share one signature, so occurrences are addressed in record order: index 0 is the male path and index 1 the female one, the same one-row-per-occurrence shape as `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE`'s `RACE\MorphGroupNames` (`MPGN`) and `RACE\SubgraphAnimationPaths` (`SAPT`). `WMAP` is not in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formid_subrecords.inc` and not in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/non_formid_slots.inc`, so it never entered the form-link path; `PTOP` and `NTOP` are already excluded for RACE by `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/non_formid_slots.inc`, and `PNAM` was excluded there before this change (it is a form ID in other records), so the new rows only add scalar addressing.
- Left without rows in the same span, still listed as RACE gaps by `Radicle/tools/parity_matrix.py:main`: `MNAM`/`FNAM` (zero-length `wbEmpty` gender markers, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:11195` and `:11198`, no bytes to address), `ANAM`/`MODT` (skeletal model and model info inside the head data structs, `:11196-11197`), `MTNM` (Movement Type Names, a repeated name string xEdit declares with an explicit size argument, `:11202`, rowed in a later lane once a fixed-width string storage existed: the RACE movement type names section below), `TINL` (a count xEdit itself marks as needing a count update, `:11206`) and `NNAM` (a per-gender neck fat float struct, `:11269`). The `VTCK`/`HCLF` pairs of `:11203` and `:11205` gained their own rows in the section below.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_race_link_rows.cpp:RaceScalarRows.FaceGenClampsChatterAndWrinkleMapsEditInPlace` asserts the four rows' subrecord, `f32` storage, whole-payload and non-repeated shape, reads the synthetic values back as `1.5`, `0.25`, `3` and `9`, edits `PNAM` and `NTOP`, rewrites the second `WMAP`, and rereads the raw bytes; the negative cases are index 1 of a single-slot row and a repeated write of the value already stored, which returns `ScalarMutationStatus::unchanged`. `Radicle/tests/test_race_link_rows.cpp:RaceScalarRows.RefuseANonFloatPayloadForAWholePayloadRow` shows a two-byte `PNAM` raising `ScalarError` from both `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:record_field_count` and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:write_scalar` with the plugin bytes unchanged.
- Parity: `Radicle/tools/parity_matrix.py:main` regenerated `Radicle/docs/FO4_PARITY.md` (RACE 48 to 52 scalar rows and 11 to 12 string rows, and the repeated-column count 20 to 21).

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE voice and default hair color rows (#602 C-26)

- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE` gains `RACE\VoiceTypeMale`/`RACE\VoiceTypeFemale` on `VTCK` and `RACE\HairColorMale`/`RACE\HairColorFemale` on `HCLF`, the two-element `wbArray(VTCK, 'Voices', wb form-ID-check call with target VTYP, ['Male', 'Female'])` and `wbArray(HCLF, 'Default Hair Colors', wb form-ID-check call on [NULL, CLFM], ['Male', 'Female'])` of `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:11203` and `:11205`. Each is one 8-byte subrecord holding two form IDs, so the pair is two rows on the same subrecord at `offset` 0 and 4, not a `repeated` row: `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:formlink_slots` gives a non-repeated, non-strided row exactly one slot at its offset, and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:set_record_formlink_field` indexes that slot, which is the same fixed-offset shape `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:EXPL` uses for `EXPL\Sound1`/`EXPL\Sound2` inside `DATA`.
- The rows carry no `payload_sizes`, so a `VTCK` shorter or longer than eight bytes is not refused outright: `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` marks the slot past the payload `misfit`, and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:set_record_formlink_field` throws `FormLinkFieldError` only when that slot is written. `VTCK` targets `VTYP` only, so the two voice rows are not nullable, while `HCLF` lists `NULL` and keeps `nullable: true`; `Radicle/src/graph/check_errors.cpp:slot_targets` now answers `VTYP` and `CLFM` for these offsets instead of leaving them unreported, which turns a wrong-type value in a `RACE` voice or hair color slot into `CheckCode::wrong_target_type`.
- `VTCK` and `HCLF` are already in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formid_subrecords.inc`, so `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:collect_form_links` already found and renumbered both four-byte slots generically; the rows only add the typed slot, and `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:visit_formlink_offsets` de-duplicates the two paths, so neither slot is remapped twice. Nothing had to leave `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/unclaimed_link_allowlist.inc`.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_race_link_rows.cpp:RaceLinkRows.VoiceAndHairColorSlotsEditTheirOwnHalf` asserts each row's subrecord, offset 0 and 4, non-repeated address, empty `payload_sizes`, single-validator slot count and one-target pool, reads the two 8-byte payloads back, rewrites the female voice and the male hair color, rereads all four raw IDs, and rejects a local `ARMO` target in both a `VTYP` and a `CLFM` slot with `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:FormLinkFieldError`. `Radicle/tests/test_race_link_rows.cpp:RaceLinkRows.RefuseAVoiceSlotThatDoesNotFitThePayload` shows a four-byte `VTCK` still takes a write to the male offset while the female offset throws, which is the `misfit` path.
- Corpus: none read here -- the official masters are not reachable from this worktree, so `CheckErrors.VanillaMasterHasNoErrorFindings` is what decides whether every vanilla `RACE` `VTCK`/`HCLF` is eight bytes.
