## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMO model list rows (#602 A-13 A-15)

- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMO` gains the model list xEdit builds as `wbRArray('Models', wbRStruct('Model', [wbInteger(INDX, 'Addon Index', itU16), wb form-ID-check call on `MODL` with target `ARMA`]))`, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:5822-5827`. Radicle expresses the pair as two `repeated: true` rows, `ARMO\ModelAddonIndex` (`INDX`, whole-payload `u16`, `presentation: identity`, bounds 0 to 65535) and `ARMO\ModelArmorAddon` (`MODL`, offset 0, target `ARMA`, `payload_sizes: [4]`, `nullable: false`), so the i-th index pairs with the i-th addon. That is the one-row-per-occurrence shape `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMO` already uses for `ARMO\ResistanceAmount`/`ARMO\ResistanceType` (stride 8 inside `DAMA`) and the RACE `MTYP`/`QNAM` rows use for their own repeated pairs.
- `MODL` is deliberately absent from `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formid_subrecords.inc`: it is a model filename string in most records and a form ID only in ARMO and ARMA, so the generic table cannot list it. The rows are claimed through `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_schema.cpp:schema_formlink_offsets`, which is what `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:visit_formlink_offsets` consults before the generic signature scan, so `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:collect_form_links` reports the hits and `Radicle/src/graph/check_errors.cpp:slot_targets` validates the `ARMA` target.
- Both rows are `insertion: existing_only` and edit-only. The `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMO` `authoring` block still stops at `DATA`, so `create_armo` writes no model list and a record created from a form key has no `INDX`/`MODL` to edit.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_armo_arma_rows.cpp:ModelListRowsAreRepeatedIndicesAndAddonLinks` checks the subrecords, offset, storage, bounds, repeated address, one-target pool and that `65536` is refused by `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:encode_scalar`; `Radicle/tests/test_armo_arma_rows.cpp:EditsTheModelListByIndex` counts both rows on the synthetic fixture, rewrites the second `INDX` and the second `MODL`, and rereads all four payloads. Negative cases: index 2 of either row returns `subrecord_missing`, and a local `ARMO` target where `ARMA` is required throws `Radicle/src/schema/formlink_lists.cpp:formlink_field_target_allowed`'s `FormLinkFieldError` with the bytes left unmodified.
- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMA` gains `ARMA\AdditionalRaces`, the repeated link xEdit builds as `wbRArrayS('Additional Races', wb form-ID-check call on `MODL` with target `RACE` and `NULL`)`, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:5885`. It is `repeated: true` with `payload_sizes: [4]` and `nullable: true` (xEdit lists `NULL` among the targets), one link per `MODL` occurrence, the same shape as the ARMA skin texture and swap-list links; the record's own race stays `ARMA\Race` (`RNAM`) and the additional races are the `MODL` occurrences after it. `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:visit_link_offsets` has no ARMA branch, so the row is the only thing that reads `MODL` as a form ID there, and `MODL` stays out of `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formid_subrecords.inc` for the reason given above.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_armo_arma_rows.cpp:AdditionalRacesAreRepeatedNullableRaceLinks` asserts the row shape and that a `NULL` write is accepted at index 0 while index 1 returns `subrecord_missing`, then rereads the payload as four zero bytes; the `ARMA\AdditionalRaces` entry in the `Radicle/tests/test_armo_arma_rows.cpp:k_link_rows` table puts the subrecord, offset, target and nullability under `ARMOARMARows.WholePayloadAndLinkRowsNameTheirSubrecordsAndTargets`.
- Parity: `Radicle/tools/parity_matrix.py:main` regenerated `Radicle/docs/FO4_PARITY.md` (ARMO 14 to 15 scalar rows and 11 to 12 link rows, ARMA 7 to 8 link rows).

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMA and ARMO material swap rows (#602 A-13 A-15)

- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMA` gains `ARMA\BipedMaleMaterialSwap` (`MO2S`), `ARMA\BipedFemaleMaterialSwap` (`MO3S`), `ARMA\FirstPersonMaleMaterialSwap` (`MO4S`) and `ARMA\FirstPersonFemaleMaterialSwap` (`MO5S`); `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMO` gains `ARMO\MaleMaterialSwap` (`MO2S`) and `ARMO\FemaleMaterialSwap` (`MO4S`). Every row is offset 0, `payload_sizes: [4]`, `nullable: false` and `insertion: existing_only`, with `MSWP` as its only target. xEdit: `wbMO2S` to `wbMO5S` are the wb form-ID-check calls on `MO2S` to `MO5S`, each with 'Material Swap' as its label and `MSWP` as its only target, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:4251-4254`, reached through `Core/wbDefinitionsCommon.pas:wbTexturedModel` for ARMO's Male and Female world models (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:5800`, `:5806`) and ARMA's Biped Model and 1st Person models (`:5872-5873`, `:5877-5878`), whose rows are `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMA` and `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMO`. xEdit lists no `NULL` among the targets and marks none of them optional, so the rows are not nullable.
- `Radicle/tools/formlink_schema_codegen.py:load_lists` reads `formlink_fields` per record, so `MO2S` carries one row for ARMO (Male world model) and another for ARMA (Biped Model Male), and `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:formlink_field_descriptor(Signature, std::string_view)` keeps the lookup record-scoped; `Radicle/src/schema/formlink_slots.cpp:formlink_field_at` takes the record's own rows, so the two `MO2S` rows never collide.
- These four signatures (`MO2S` to `MO5S`) were already in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formid_subrecords.inc` (the xEdit form-ID-check signature list), so `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:collect_form_links` and the generic remap branch already found and renumbered them. What the rows add is the typed slot: `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_schema.cpp:schema_formlink_offsets` reports the offsets, `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:visit_formlink_offsets` unions them with the generic path and de-duplicates, so no slot is remapped twice, and `Radicle/src/graph/check_errors.cpp:slot_targets` now answers `MSWP` instead of `nullopt`, which turns a target of the wrong type from an unreported slot into `CheckCode::wrong_target_type`. `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:set_record_formlink_field` can now write the link, and `Radicle/src/schema/formlink_slots.cpp:formlink_field_at` resolves it for that validation.
- A `0` in one of these slots stays invisible to `Radicle/src/graph/check_errors.cpp:check_links`, which skips null and none raw values before it asks for slot targets, so the non-nullable rows cannot raise a finding on a master that stores an empty swap.
- Corpus: none read here. The official masters were not reachable from this worktree and no target-type mismatch is proven against them, so `CheckErrors.VanillaMasterHasNoErrorFindings` is the check that decides.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_armo_arma_rows.cpp:MaterialSwapRowsReadAndEditTheMSWPLink` reads the six raw links out of the synthetic plugin, rejects a `NULL` write and a wrong-type local target with `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:FormLinkFieldError`, returns `subrecord_missing` past the single slot, writes one link and rereads its encoded raw value. The six rows also join the `Radicle/tests/test_armo_arma_rows.cpp:k_link_rows` table used by `ARMOARMARows.WholePayloadAndLinkRowsNameTheirSubrecordsAndTargets`, which asserts each row's subrecord, offset, `MSWP` target, payload size and nullability.
- Parity: `Radicle/tools/parity_matrix.py:main` regenerated `Radicle/docs/FO4_PARITY.md` (ARMA 8 to 12 link rows, ARMO 12 to 14).

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMA and ARMO model file name rows (#602 A-13 A-15)

- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMA` gains string rows `ARMA\BipedMaleModel` (`MOD2`), `ARMA\BipedFemaleModel` (`MOD3`), `ARMA\FirstPersonMaleModel` (`MOD4`) and `ARMA\FirstPersonFemaleModel` (`MOD5`); `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMO` gains `ARMO\MaleWorldModel` (`MOD2`) and `ARMO\FemaleWorldModel` (`MOD4`). All six are `kind: string`, label "Model file name" and `insertion: existing_only`, the same shape as `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:STAT`'s `STAT\Model` (`MODL`). xEdit: the model filename members of `Core/wbDefinitionsCommon.pas:wbTexturedModel`, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:5800` and `:5806` for ARMO's Male and Female world models and `:5872-5873` and `:5877-5878` for ARMA's Biped Model and 1st Person models.
- These signatures are absent from `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formid_subrecords.inc` on purpose: `MOD2` to `MOD5` are filenames in ARMO and ARMA and, unlike `MODL`, are not a form ID in any FO4 record, so `Radicle/src/schema/form_links.cpp:collect_form_links` never treats them as links and no remap rule is needed. `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_mixed.cpp:packed_formid_array_offsets` lists only `MODL` for ARMO and ARMA, so a filename of exactly four bytes is not remapped.
- The rows give the schema the edit path the typed setters already had: `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/armor.hpp:set_armor_model_fields` and `PluginEditTool/native/src/plugin/RadiclePluginArmor.cpp:RadiclePluginBackend::setArmorField` write these subrecords under their own paths (`ARMO\MaleWorldModel`, `ARMA\MaleBipedModel`, ...), while `Radicle/include/fo4/plugin/mutation.hpp:set_record_string` now reaches the same subrecords by row path. `Radicle/include/fo4/plugin/mutation.hpp:set_record_scalar` refuses them, because `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:write_scalar` requires the string setter for a `ScalarStorage::zstring` row.
- `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:scalar_descriptor(Signature)` stays `nullopt` for `MOD2` to `MOD5`: two records now carry a `MOD2` row, so the signature-only lookup is ambiguous, and the function also rejects `zstring` rows. Every production caller resolves rows through `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:scalar_fields(Signature)` or a path, so nothing depends on the signature-only answer.
- Corpus: none read here; the rows carry no payload size and no version gate, so any length is accepted, and the writer rejects an embedded NUL the way `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:write_scalar` encodes the value.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_armo_arma_rows.cpp:ModelFileRowsReadAndWriteTheFilename` asserts each row's subrecord and storage, reads the six filenames out of the synthetic plugin, rejects the scalar setter with `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:ScalarError`, returns `subrecord_missing` past the single occurrence, writes one filename per record and rereads them.
- Parity: `Radicle/tools/parity_matrix.py:main` regenerated `Radicle/docs/FO4_PARITY.md` (ARMA 4 string rows, ARMO 2).
- `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ARMO` also gains the four icon strings the same creators write: `ARMO\MaleIcon` (`ICON`), `ARMO\MaleMessageIcon` (`MICO`), `ARMO\FemaleIcon` (`ICO2`) and `ARMO\FemaleMessageIcon` (`MIC2`), the members of `wbRStruct('Male', [wbTexturedModel('World Model', [MOD2, MO2T], [wbMODC, wbMO2S, nil]), wbString(ICON, 'Icon Image'), wbString(MICO, 'Message Icon')])` and its Female twin (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:5799-5812`), with the `ALCH\Icon` and `ALCH\MessageIcon` shape (`Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:ALCH`). `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/armor.hpp:Armor` carries them as `male_icon`, `male_message_icon`, `female_icon` and `female_message_icon`, which `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/armor.hpp:create_armor` writes, so the rows are the missing edit path for those create-only values. Neither `ICON`, `MICO`, `ICO2` nor `MIC2` is in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formid_subrecords.inc`, so nothing remaps them.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_armo_arma_rows.cpp:ModelFileRowsReadAndWriteTheFilename` covers the four icon rows with the same table and write-and-reread checks, including one message icon edit.
## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:WEAP (#602 C-54)

- Scope: WEAP gains three `existing_only` scalar rows over the two anonymous byte runs: `WEAP\UnknownAfterAnimationAttackSeconds` (`subrecord: DNAM`, offset 110, `u16`, 0..65535), `WEAP\UnknownEnd` (`DNAM`, offset 128, `u32`, 0..4294967295) and `WEAP\BoltAnimationSeconds` (`subrecord: FNAM`, offset 20, `u32`, 0..4294967295).
- xEdit: `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:12988` (`wbByteArray('Unknown', 2)`), `:12993` (`wbByteArray('Unknown', 4)`) and `:13001` (`wbByteArray('Bolt Anim Seconds', 4)`), inside `wbStruct(DNAM, 'Data', ...)` at `:12911` and `wbStruct(FNAM, '', ...)` at `:12995`. xEdit types all three as untyped byte arrays with no sub-members or enum, so each row names the whole run.
- Offsets follow the dense DNAM and FNAM layout: `WEAP\AnimationAttackSeconds` (106, f32) ends at 110 and `WEAP\Stagger` (124, u32) ends at 128, where the two runs begin and where the 132-byte DNAM payload ends; `WEAP\AnimationReloadSeconds` (16, f32) ends at 20 and `WEAP\SightedTransitionSeconds` (24, f32) begins at 24, inside the 41-byte FNAM payload. The u16 run is the low half of the 2 bytes xEdit declares, not a widened 4-byte read.
- `Radicle/docs/WEAPONS.md` no longer lists the two runs as not covered: both are rowed and read and written like the neighbouring scalars.
- Short payloads: all three rows are embedded with `payload_size` 132 (DNAM) and 41 (FNAM), so `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` marks the slot invalid and the reader reports the field absent rather than zero, and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:write_scalar` returns `subrecord_missing` for it.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_weap_rows.cpp` (`WeapRows`) checks the three offsets decode, a save-and-reparse round trip (`Radicle/src/plugin/writer.cpp:write_plugin` with `Radicle/src/plugin/reader.cpp:read_plugin`) that asserts the bytes at DNAM 110, DNAM 128 and FNAM 20 after `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:set_record_scalar` while DNAM offset 4 stays byte-identical, an Ammo FormLink write (`Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:set_record_formlink_field`) surviving save and reparse with both runs untouched, and the negative cases: 131-byte DNAM and 40-byte FNAM payloads hide their rows and refuse the write, and a 65536 write throws `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:ScalarError` with the plugin bytes unchanged.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_ lists (#602 B-51 B-6)

- Scope: NPC_ gains three repeated FormLink rows, all `insertion: existing_only`: `NPC\Package` (`subrecord: PKID`, offset 0, targets PACK), `NPC\HeadPart` (`PNAM`, offset 0, HDPT) and `NPC\Spell` (`SPLO`, offset 0, SPEL and LVSP). Each is `nullable: false` and `repeated: true`, so one row covers every link of its list and the neighbours of the written subrecord stay byte-identical. `NPC\Package` and `NPC\HeadPart` also carry `payload_sizes: [4]`; `NPC\Spell` no longer does, because it later moved into the `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\Spells` group, where the member descriptor holds the 4-byte rule (see `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/generated_scalar_fields.inc:k_subrecord_groups`).
- xEdit: Packages at `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:10400` (a repeated 'Packages' list of form ID members, PKID 'Package' allowing [PACK]), head parts at `:10417` ('Head Parts', PNAM 'Head Part', [HDPT]), spells at `:10372` (`wbSPLOs`, a repeated list whose member is SPLO 'Actor Effect', [SPEL, LVSP], at `:3284`).
- The SPLO count subrecord SPCT (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:10371`, count at `:3283`) is now rowed and maintained: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\SpellCount` is the group count of `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\Spells`, so `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:insert_record_subrecord_group` and `remove_record_subrecord_group` rewrite it. `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:RACE\ActorEffects` rows the same xEdit list shape at `:11063` and still has no count row.
- PKID and SPLO are already in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formid_subrecords.inc`, and PNAM is listed there too, so remap of these links is unchanged by the rows.
- Name lookups: PNAM and SPLO are shared subrecord signatures (PNAM has rows in many records, SPLO also backs `RACE\ActorEffects`), so these rows must be resolved by record plus path (`Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:formlink_field_descriptor`), never by signature alone.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_npc_link_rows.cpp` (`NpcLinkRows`) checks the three descriptors (record, subrecord, offset, repeated, payload size, nullable, target allow-lists) and a save-and-reparse of a synthetic NPC_ with three PKID, two PNAM and two SPLO links: writing index 1, 0 and 1 changes exactly those links, an out-of-range index reports `subrecord_missing`, a NULL target and a wrong target type for a local record throw `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:FormLinkFieldError`, and an eight-byte PKID payload is refused. After the `NPC_\Spells` conversion the same fixture carries `SPCT` 2 before its two `SPLO`, and `NpcLinkRows.PackageHeadPartAndSpellRowsDeclareRepeatedTargets` pins the group descriptor beside the link row, `NpcLinkRows.RepeatedWritesReachOnlyTheirOwnSubrecord` reads both links and both PKID/PNAM writes, then inserts a run at index 1 and removes the one at index 0 and asserts `SPCT` reads 3 and then 2 with the subrecord order `PKID PKID PKID PNAM PNAM SPCT SPLO SPLO`, `NpcLinkRows.OutOfRangeIndexNullAndWrongTargetTypeAreRefused` adds `Radicle/include/fo4/plugin/mutation.hpp:SubrecordGroupMutationStatus::index_out_of_range` for a remove at index 2 while the links stay byte-identical, and `NpcLinkRows.SpellCountThatDisagreesWithTheRunIsRefusedAtomically` feeds `SPCT` 3 with two `SPLO` and requires both the insert and the remove to throw `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:SubrecordGroupError` with `Radicle/src/plugin/writer.cpp:write_plugin` returning the input bytes.
- Status of the first B-51 and B-6 rows (anchored at `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_`): attacks, actor sounds, face morphs, tint layers and the OBTS header now have rows (`NPC_\AttackDamageMult`, `NPC_\ActorSounds`, `NPC_\FaceMorphIndex`, `NPC_\TintLayerValue`, `NPC_\ObjectTemplateDefault`), and the open parts are listed in the sections below. Template actors TPTA were rowed later, see the template actor link section below. APPR on NPC_ and FURN is a packed FormLink list (a repeated 'Attach Parent Slots' list of form ID members, 'Keyword' [KYWD], at `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:5275`), so it needs a `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:formlink_lists` entry like `RACE\AttachParentSlots`, not a plain row.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN marker parameters (#602 B-11 B-14)

- Scope: FURN gains five strided scalar rows and one strided FormLink row over the marker parameter array in one SNAM subrecord: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\MarkerOffsetX` (offset 0), `FURN\MarkerOffsetY` (4), `FURN\MarkerOffsetZ` (8), `FURN\MarkerRotationZ` (12) and `FURN\MarkerEntryTypes` (offset 20, u8, flags), plus `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\MarkerKeyword` (offset 16, KYWD, nullable). All six use `stride: 24` and `insertion: existing_only`; the five scalar rows also carry `min_form_version: 125`. The FormLink row has no version gate: `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:FormLinkFieldDescriptor` carries only `max_form_version` and `Radicle/tools/formlink_schema_codegen.py` reads only that key, so a below-125 payload is hidden for that row by the misalignment rule alone.
- xEdit: `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:5314` (`wbSNAMMarkerParams`, `wbArray(SNAM, 'Marker Parameters', wbStruct('Marker', [...]))`), reached from FURN at `:6915`. Its members are the three offset floats at 0, 4 and 8, `wbFloatAngle('Rotation Z')` at 12, the form ID member 'Keyword' [KYWD, NULL] at 16, and the two `wbFromVersion(125, ...)` members, `Entry Types` (u8 flags) at 20 and three unknown bytes at 21.
- Element size: the v125 element is 24 bytes. Below 125 the two gated members are absent, so the element is 20 bytes, and `SetOptionalFrom(4)` also allows a 16-byte element that ends after the keyword. A Radicle address carries one static stride, so only the 24-byte element is rowed; a payload that is not a whole number of elements is marked misaligned by `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots`, every row then resolves to absent, and writes report `subrecord_missing` (`Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:write_scalar`). A pre-125 or truncated array is therefore hidden rather than misread. The `min_form_version` gate keeps the same rows hidden on a record below 125.
- Double count: `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_schema.cpp:schema_formlink_offsets` skips every subrecord the mixed handlers claim, and FURN and TERM SNAM are claimed by `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_mixed.cpp:record_stride_form_id_offsets` (`k_record_stride_layouts`), so `FURN\MarkerKeyword` adds no second keyword link to the graph. Typed reads and writes still work, because `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:formlink_slots` resolves the row's own slots and never consults the mixed handler.
- The three unknown bytes at offset 21 have no row: they are a byte run with no xEdit members.
- Corpus: this worktree has no Fallout 4 masters, so the 24-byte element and the 125 gate rest on xEdit alone and are not verified against shipped SNAM payloads.
- Title, group and count: the SNAM array has no count subrecord, so it is not a Radicle counted array; `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\Properties` (PRPS) already covers the property list, and the ENAM, NAM0 and FNPR marker rows plus the COCT/CNTO items group came with #653.
- Closed in B-11 and B-14: adding and removing marker entries. The ENAM and NAM0 marker pairs have no count subrecord, and both existing mutation concepts (counted arrays and subrecord groups, `Radicle/include/fo4/plugin/mutation.hpp:insert_record_counted_element` and `insert_record_subrecord_group`) require one, so they use the count-less group below. Tested by `Radicle/tests/test_furn_rows.cpp:FurnRows.MarkerGroupPairsEnamWithNam0AndNamesNoCount`, `FurnRows.InsertsAMarkerPairBetweenTwoExistingOnes` and `FurnRows.RemovesOneMarkerPairAndLeavesTheOtherAlone`. FNPR entries are closed for add and remove too: `FurnRows.InsertsAndAppendsAMarkerEntryPointBeforeTheMarkerModel` and `FurnRows.RemovesOneMarkerEntryPointAndLeavesTheOtherAlone`. Still open: adding and removing SNAM marker parameters. The rows (`Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\MarkerKeyword` and its siblings) are `existing_only`, and their read and write are tested in `Radicle/tests/test_furn_marker_params.cpp`.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\Markers (#602 B-11)

- Scope: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\Markers` is a count-less subrecord group (`kind: subrecord_group` with no `count_subrecord`) whose members are the 4-byte ENAM marker index and the 4-byte NAM0 disabled entry points, both required and non-repeatable, exactly the two subrecords xEdit pairs in one `wbRStruct('Marker', [...])` element at `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:6902`.
- Generator: `Radicle/tools/schema_codegen.py:parse_subrecord_group` accepts an absent or empty `count_subrecord` and rejects anything else that is not four printable characters, and `Radicle/tools/subrecord_group_render.py:render_subrecord_groups` emits `Signature{}` for it. `Radicle/tools/schema_codegen.py:load_schema` skips its whole-payload u32 count row check and keeps an empty count signature out of the counted-array sharing check for such a group. Nothing else in the schema changes: the FURN\MarkerIndex, FURN\MarkerDisabledPoints and FURN\MarkerEntry* rows keep their own addresses, and the group reuses them.
- Mutation: `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:insert_record_subrecord_group` and `remove_record_subrecord_group` now compute `counted` from `group.count_subrecord != Signature{}` and gate both the count-subrecord creation and `write_counter` on it, so an uncounted group inserts its required members at `spans[index].first`, or at `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:first_successor_index` for an append, and removes a whole run, with no counter to keep in step. `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:is_subrecord_group_count_subrecord` no longer reports a null count signature as a count subrecord, so an empty `count_subrecord` cannot make an unrelated subrecord look maintained by a group.
- Successors: the group lists FNPR, XMRK, SNAM, APPR, OBTE and NVNM, the signatures that follow the markers array in xEdit's FURN order (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:6902-6917`), so an appended pair lands before the marker entry point array instead of at the end of the record. A new pair is zero-filled, ENAM index 0 and NAM0 with no disabled points, the way xEdit inserts one.
- Fail closed: `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:group_spans` refuses a run without its required member, so a lone ENAM makes `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:scalar_slots` raise `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:ScalarError` for that record's marker rows rather than read a half pair, and the same refusal reaches insert and remove as `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:SubrecordGroupError`.
- Corpus: this worktree has no Fallout 4 masters, so that every shipped FURN record carries its ENAM and NAM0 markers as complete pairs is taken from xEdit alone and is not verified against shipped records.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_furn_rows.cpp:MarkerGroupPairsEnamWithNam0AndNamesNoCount` checks the descriptor, `Radicle/tests/test_furn_rows.cpp:InsertsAMarkerPairBetweenTwoExistingOnes` and `AppendsAMarkerPairBeforeTheFirstSuccessor` check the inserted bytes and the placement before FNPR after a save and reparse, `RemovesOneMarkerPairAndLeavesTheOtherAlone` checks removal, `MarkerPairInsertAndRemoveRefuseIndexesPastTheEnd` checks both out-of-range statuses leave the record untouched, and `AnEnamWithoutItsNam0IsRefusedRatherThanTreatedAsAPair` checks the two refusals above.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_furn_marker_params.cpp` (`FurnMarkerParams`) checks the six descriptors (subrecord, offsets, stride, gate, storage, presentation, flag names, keyword nullable), a save-and-reparse of two 24-byte elements where writes to element 1 and to the keyword at element 1 leave the neighbouring bytes and element 0 untouched, and the negative cases: a 24-byte payload refuses element 1, a 124 record and a 32-byte payload hide every row and refuse writes, a keyword write to a FURN record throws `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:FormLinkFieldError`, and an out-of-range u8 entry type throws `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:ScalarError`.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\MarkerEntryPointList (#602 B-11 B-14)

- Scope: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\MarkerEntryPointList` is a count-less subrecord group whose single member is the 4-byte FNPR marker entry point, required and non-repeatable, which gives add and remove of one FNPR entry through `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:insert_record_subrecord_group` and `remove_record_subrecord_group`. xEdit keeps the array uncounted (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:6911` (TODO-verify: line numbers read from a local xEdit copy, not the pinned 93cc0bc5), `wbRArray('Marker Entry Points', wbStruct(FNPR, 'Marker', [Type u16, Entry Points u16]))`), so there is no count subrecord to keep in step and the group has none.
- Successors: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\MarkerEntryPointList` lists XMRK, SNAM, APPR, OBTE and NVNM, the signatures that follow the FNPR array in xEdit's FURN order (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:6911-6917` (TODO-verify: line numbers read from a local xEdit copy, not the pinned 93cc0bc5)), so an appended entry lands before the marker model string instead of at the end of the record. A new entry is four zero bytes, xEdit's own zero-filled insert.
- Rows unchanged: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\MarkerEntryType` (u16 at offset 0) and `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\MarkerEntryPoints` (u16 flags at offset 2) keep their own addresses and stay `existing_only`; the group reuses them, the same overlap `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\Markers` has with `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\MarkerIndex`. FNPR is rowed on FURN alone, so the signature-only lookup still resolves both.
- Fail closed: `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:group_spans` enforces the declared 4-byte member size, so a truncated FNPR makes `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:scalar_slots` raise `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:ScalarError` for that record's entry point rows instead of reading a half entry.
- Still open in B-11 and B-14: the SNAM marker parameters stay `existing_only`, and FNPR entries have no typed write for the entry point flags beyond the two half-entry rows above.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_furn_rows.cpp:MarkerEntryPointListNamesItsSingleFnprMemberAndNoCount` checks the descriptor, `InsertsAndAppendsAMarkerEntryPointBeforeTheMarkerModel` checks the inserted bytes and both placements after a save and reparse, `RemovesOneMarkerEntryPointAndLeavesTheOtherAlone` checks removal, and `MarkerEntryPointInsertAndRemoveRefuseIndexesPastTheEnd` checks both out-of-range statuses leave the record untouched.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_ template actor links (#602 B-51 B-6)

- Scope: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\TemplateActorTraits` and its twelve siblings (Stats, Factions, SpellList, AIData, AIPackages, ModelAnimation, BaseData, Inventory, Script, DefaultPackageList, AttackData, Keywords) row the thirteen 4-byte template actor links of one TPTA subrecord at offsets 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40, 44 and 48. All thirteen are `insertion: existing_only`, `nullable: true` and carry no `payload_sizes`, so a write only lands when the subrecord is large enough for that link.
- xEdit: `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:10353` (`wbStruct(TPTA, 'Template Actors', [...]`) with thirteen `wbNPCTemplateActorEntry` members, each a nullable form ID member at `Core/wbDefinitionsCommon.pas:8274` (`wbNPCTemplateActorEntry`, targets BMMO, LVLN, NPC_ and NULL, `cpNormalIgnoreEmpty`). The NULL in the list is what makes the rows nullable; BMMO, LVLN and NPC_ become the row targets and every other signature is refused.
- Double count: `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_mixed.cpp:packed_formid_array_offsets` already scans NPC_ TPTA as a packed form ID array, so `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_schema.cpp:struct_or_mixed_handler_owns` makes the graph skip the subrecord and the thirteen rows add no second link per offset. Typed reads and writes still work because `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:formlink_slots` resolves the row's own address.
- Out-of-payload slots throw rather than report missing: `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` marks a link whose `offset + 4` runs past the payload as `misfit`, and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:set_record_formlink_field` raises `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:FormLinkFieldError` for a misfit slot while an index past the resolved slot count returns `subrecord_missing`.
- Still open in B-51 and B-6 after this: attack add and remove (the attack read and write rows are closed below), and OBTE, OBTF and STOP (not rowed, see the object template section below). Actor sounds, tint layers, face morphs and the OBTS header are closed by the sections below, anchored at `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_`.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_npc_template_actor_rows.cpp` (`NpcTemplateActorRows`) checks all thirteen descriptors (subrecord, offset, nullable, non-repeated, target allow-list including a refused WEAP), a save-and-reparse of a 52-byte TPTA where writes to the Traits, AttackData and Keywords slots change only those three words and a repeat write reports `unchanged`, a NULL target accepted on a nullable row with an index past the slot count reporting `subrecord_missing`, a WEAP target throwing `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:FormLinkFieldError`, and a 12-byte payload that accepts the offset 8 write while the offset 48 write throws.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_ attack data rows (#602 B-51 B-6)

- Scope: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\AttackDamageMult` and nine siblings row the ten scalar members of the 44-byte ATKD payload at offsets 0 (f32 Damage Mult), 4 (f32 Attack Chance), 12 (u32 Attack Flags, presentation flags with xEdit's 32 names), 16 (f32 Attack Angle), 20 (f32 Strike Angle), 24 (f32 Stagger), 28 (f32 Knockdown), 32 (f32 Recovery Time), 36 (f32 Action Points Mult) and 40 (i32 Stagger Offset), all `repeated: true`, `payload_size: 44` and `insertion: existing_only`. `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\AttackSpell` rows the form ID member at offset 8 as a nullable SPEL link, `repeated: true` with `payload_sizes: [44]`.
- Repeated instance, not repeated member: xEdit wraps the payload in `wbAttackData` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:4073`, `wbRStructSK([1], 'Attack', [ATKD, ATKE])`) and NPC_ uses it as `wbRArrayS('Attacks', wbAttackData)` at `:10377`, so one record may carry several ATKD subrecords. The rows therefore cover one instance each instead of a stride inside one subrecord, exactly as `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\Spell` covers each SPLO subrecord: `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` turns every matching non-repeated-instance subrecord into one slot, so index 0 is the first attack, index 1 the second, and an index past the last reports `subrecord_missing`. A stride row would have been wrong here because the members are not elements of one payload.
- xEdit: `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:4074` (`wbStruct(ATKD, 'Attack Data', [`) reached from NPC_ at `:10377`; the members are quoted from `:4075-4118`. ATKD has no `SetOptionalFrom`, so the payload is 44 bytes and `payload_size: 44` holds every instance to that size; ATKE (`:4120`, `wbString`) follows each ATKD.
- ATKE has no row: Radicle scalar storage covers f32, i32, u16, u32, u8 and the localized string path only, so a null-terminated non-localized string (`wbString`) needs new storage rather than a row. It stays listed in `Radicle/docs/NPCS.md` (Not covered).
- Shared subrecord: RACE carries the same `wbAttackData` array (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:11211`), so the rows are reached by record plus path through `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:scalar_field_descriptor(Signature, std::string_view)`; a signature-only `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:scalar_descriptor` lookup stays reserved for whole-payload rows.
- Short payloads: the declared `payload_size` of 44 makes `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` mark a truncated ATKD instance unsized, so every member of that instance reads absent and both `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:write_scalar` and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:set_record_formlink_field` report `subrecord_missing` for it. The payload is left untouched rather than resized.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_npc_attack_data_rows.cpp` (`NpcAttackDataRows`) checks all ten scalar descriptors and the link descriptor (repeated, payload size 44, nullable, target allow-list including a refused WEAP), a 44-byte ATKD read at five offsets and a save-and-reparse where writes to AttackDamageMult, AttackFlags, AttackStaggerOffset and the AttackSpell link change only those words and leave the f32 neighbours byte-identical, two ATKD instances whose first instance is byte-identical after a write to index 1, a 24-byte instance where every member reads absent and refuses both a scalar and a link write while its bytes are preserved, and the negative cases: a WEAP link target throws `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:FormLinkFieldError`, an index past the last instance reports `subrecord_missing`, and a u32 write past 4294967295 throws `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:ScalarError`.
- Still open in B-51 and B-6 for attacks: adding or removing an attack. ATKD and ATKE have no count subrecord and no terminator, so the existing counted-array and subrecord-group insert paths (`Radicle/include/fo4/plugin/mutation.hpp:insert_record_counted_element`, `insert_record_subrecord_group`) cannot express the pair, and ATKE is rowed as `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\AttackEvent` (read and write tested by `Radicle/tests/test_npc_attack_data_rows.cpp`).

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_ face morph and tint layer rows (#602 B-51 B-6)

- Scope: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\FaceMorphIndex` rows the whole 4-byte FMRI payload (u32, `repeated: true`); `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\FaceMorphPositionX` and its six siblings row the FMRS payload at offsets 0 (position X/Y/Z at 0/4/8), 12 (rotation X/Y/Z at 12/16/20) and 24 (scale), all f32, `repeated: true`, `insertion: existing_only`, with `minimum_payload_size` 28 and no `payload_size`, checked by `Radicle/tests/test_npc_face_tint_rows.cpp`. `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\TintLayerDataType` (offset 0, u16, enum with the two named values) and `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\TintLayerIndex` (offset 2, u16) row the 4-byte TETI payload. `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\TintLayerValue` (offset 0, u8), `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\TintLayerColorRed` and its two siblings (offsets 1, 2, 3, u8) and `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\TintLayerTemplateColorIndex` (offset 5, i16) row the TEND payload.
- Two TEND payload widths: every TEND in `Fallout4.esm` is either 1 byte (6169 of 8618 layers) or 7 bytes (2449), measured by walking the NPC_ groups of Fallout4.esm at form version 131. A single `payload_size` cannot express both, because `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` requires `data.size() == shape.payload_size` when one is declared, so the TEND rows declare `minimum_payload_size` instead (1 for the value, 5 for the colour bytes, 7 for the template colour index) and leave `payload_size` at 0, which accepts any payload at least that long. A 1-byte TEND therefore exposes only `NPC_\TintLayerValue` and refuses a colour or template index write with `subrecord_missing`.
- FMRS is an open-ended struct, not a fixed 36 bytes: xEdit wraps the payload as seven floats plus `wbByteArray('Unknown')` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:10475-10484`), an unbounded trailing array, so `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\FaceMorphScale` and its six siblings declare `minimum_payload_size` 28 and no `payload_size`. All 39020 FMRS payloads in `Fallout4.esm` are 36 bytes, so the trailing unknown run is eight bytes in practice and the seven values end at offset 28, but a declared `payload_size` of 36 would hide every member of a 28-to-35-byte payload that xEdit still reads. The trailing bytes are not rowed and a write leaves them untouched; `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:scalar_field_bytes` is where the two modes differ, an exact match for `payload_size` against at-least for `minimum_payload_size`. Boundary kept by `Radicle/tests/test_npc_face_tint_rows.cpp`.
- TEND byte order: offset 4 of a 7-byte TEND is the unused byte of xEdit's `wbByteColors` (`Core/wbDefinitionsCommon.pas:6696-6708`, `wbInteger('Red'/'Green'/'Blue')` then `wbUnused(1)`), so the template colour index sits at 5, not 4.
- Instance, not element: FMRI and each FMRS are separate subrecords, so `repeated: true` gives one slot per instance and index 0 is the first face morph. The value in `NPC_\TintLayerValue` is xEdit's raw byte; xEdit displays it through `wbDiv(100)` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:10455`), which Radicle does not model, so a write takes the raw byte.
- Shared subrecord: `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas` names FMRI, FMRS, TETI and TEND only inside NPC_ (`:10448-10486`), but the rows are still reached by record plus path through `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:scalar_field_descriptor(Signature, std::string_view)`, because FMRS and TEND each carry several rows and a signature-only `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:scalar_descriptor` lookup is reserved for whole-payload rows.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_npc_face_tint_rows.cpp` (`NpcFaceTintRows`) checks the eleven descriptors (subrecord, offset, storage, `minimum_payload_size` 28 on FMRS and 1, 5 or 7 on TEND, repeated), a read at every offset and a save-and-reparse where writes to PositionY, TintLayerValue, TintLayerColorBlue and FaceMorphIndex change only those bytes and leave the FMRS unknown run and the TEND unused byte at their original values, a 27-byte FMRS whose members read absent and refuse a write beside a 28-byte one that reads and writes at offset 24 and stays 28 bytes through a save-and-reparse, a 1-byte TEND that exposes only the value and refuses both deeper writes while keeping its length, a 2-byte TETI and an absent FMRS that read absent and refuse a write, two instances addressed by index, and the negative cases: an index past the last instance, an out-of-range enum, a u8 past 255, a signed 16-bit past 32767 and a u8 below zero all throw `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:ScalarError` or report `subrecord_missing`, with the subrecord bytes unchanged.
- Still open in B-51 and B-6: the MSDK/MSDV morph key and value arrays (no row; both carry a variable number of elements in one payload), and OBTE, OBTF and STOP on NPC_ and FURN (not rowed, see the object template section). Actor sounds are closed: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\ActorSounds`, with insert and remove tested in `Radicle/tests/test_npc_furn_attach_slots.cpp`.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_ and FURN object template combination rows (#602 B-51 B-6)

- Scope: six scalar rows on `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\ObjectTemplateIncludeCount` and its five siblings (PropertyCount, LevelMin, LevelMax, ParentCombinationIndex, Default), duplicated on the matching `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\ObjectTemplateIncludeCount` family. All twelve are `repeated`, `insertion: existing_only`, `minimum_payload_size: 18` and address one OBTS combination by occurrence index, so a write patches that combination's header in place and never changes the payload length.
- xEdit: `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:5499-5510` is `wbOBTSReq`, the `wbStruct(OBTS, 'Object Mod Template Item', [...])` whose fixed prefix is Include Count u32 at 0, Property Count u32 at 4, Level Min u8 at 8, an unused byte at 9, Level Max u8 at 10, an unused byte at 11, Parent Combination Index i16 at 12, Default u8 at 14, then the keyword array's count byte at 15 (`Core/wbInterface.pas:13283-13292`, prefix length 1 for `arCount = -4`), K keyword FormIDs (u32 each) at 16 through 16+4K, Min Level For Ranks u8 at 16+4K and Alt Levels Per Tier u8 at 17+4K. The template itself is `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:5520-5529`, used on NPC_ at `:10405` and on FURN at `:6917` (TODO-verify: line numbers read from a local xEdit copy, not the pinned 93cc0bc5).
- Why 18: the 18 bytes are the 15-byte fixed prefix, the keyword count byte at 15, and the two trailing bytes (Min Level For Ranks, Alt Levels Per Tier) that sit after the K keyword FormIDs, so the header is 18 + 4K bytes and the Includes start at 18 + 4K. `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_mixed.cpp:obts_formid_offsets` reads the counts at 0x00, 0x04 and 0x0F, maps keyword FormIDs at 0x10 + 4i, starts includes at 0x12 + 4K and checks `0x12 + keywords * 4 + includes * 7 + properties * 24` against the payload size. The rows declare `minimum_payload_size` rather than `payload_size` because shipped OBTS payloads run from 18 to 186 bytes.
- Rows removed: the `MinLevelForRanks` and `AltLevelsPerTier` rows for NPC_ and FURN were at fixed offsets 16 and 17, which are keyword FormID bytes whenever K > 0, so a write would overwrite a keyword. They were removed from `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json`; variable-offset fields are not rowed until the address can follow K. Regression: `Radicle/tests/test_object_base_records.cpp:KeywordedObjectTemplateHasNoFixedOffsetMinRankOrAltRows` asserts both rows stay absent and that a K=1 OBTS header round-trips with only Level Max changed.
- The keyword count byte at 15 has no row: it is a length byte xEdit derives from the keyword array, so a generic write would desync it, the same reason the OBTE combination count and the CS2H sound count stay unrowed.
- Not rowed: OBTE (a combination count with no verified count-to-run model), OBTF and STOP (empty markers with nothing to read or write), and the keyword, include and property arrays that follow the fixed prefix (variable offsets, already covered for form ID remapping by `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_mixed.cpp:obts_formid_offsets`).
- Parity: `Radicle/docs/FO4_PARITY.md` scalar row counts move from 32 to 40 for FURN and from 85 to 93 for NPC_.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_object_base_records.cpp:ObjectTemplateHeaderRowsCoverNpcAndFurn` checks the twelve descriptors and the `True` name of the Default enum, `ReadsAndEditsOneObjectTemplateCombinationHeader` reads both combinations of an NPC_ and a FURN fixture, edits LevelMax and ParentCombinationIndex by index and compares both OBTS payloads byte for byte after a save and reparse, and `ShortObjectTemplateCombinationsHideTheirHeaderRows` checks the negative cases: a 17-byte OBTS reads absent and refuses a write with `subrecord_missing` at index 0 and past the last combination, leaving the payload unchanged.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_ and FURN attach parent slots and NPC_ actor sound rows (#602 B-51 B-6)

- Scope: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\AttachParentSlots` and `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\AttachParentSlots` row the APPR subrecord as `packed_array` lists with `targets: ["KYWD"]`, `nullable: false` and `mutation: appendable`, in the same shape as the existing `RACE\AttachParentSlots` row. `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\ActorSoundKeyword` and `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\ActorSoundSound` row the two links of xEdit's sound pair as repeated 4-byte FormLink fields, and `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\ActorSoundsFinalize` rows the whole 1-byte CS2F payload.
- Anchoring the first element: a flat list anchors its first element against its sibling lists, and both records declare APPR as their only list, so the generated predecessors/successors would both be empty. `Radicle/src/schema/formlink_lists.cpp:empty_list_insertion_point` searches the declared predecessors for the last present one and then the successors, and falls back to appending when `append_when_empty` is set, so the rows carry an explicit `anchor_predecessors` list in reverse xEdit order: the NPC_ row anchors after KWDA or whichever of its predecessors appears last in the record (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:10404`), and the FURN row after XMRK (`:6916`).
- Actor sound pair: xEdit groups the sounds as `wbRStruct('Actor Sounds', [CS2H count, wbActorSounds, CS2E, CS2F])` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:10432-10436`) and `wbActorSounds` is a `wbRArrayS` of CS2K keyword plus CS2D sound pairs (`Core/wbDefinitionsCommon.pas:8399-8414`), so the two links are separate repeated subrecords: index 0 of `NPC_\ActorSoundKeyword` and index 0 of `NPC_\ActorSoundSound` are the same sound group. `CS2D` has `SetRequired` and `CS2K` lists only KYWD, so neither row is nullable; a write to a CS2D slot with a KYWD throws `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/formlink_lists.hpp:FormLinkFieldError`.
- CS2H was left unrowed in this change and is now `NPC_\ActorSoundTotal` of the `NPC_\ActorSounds` group (see `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:NPC_\ActorSounds`). CS2E is an empty marker with nothing to row.
- Measured against the masters: walking the NPC_ groups of Fallout4.esm found CS2H 4 bytes (30), CS2K 4 bytes (3), CS2D 4 bytes (30 + 3), CS2E 0 bytes (30) and CS2F 1 byte (30), and APPR payloads of 4, 8, 12, 24, 28 and 44 bytes, all whole multiples of four. FURN APPR payloads are 24 and 28 bytes. Both APPR lists therefore need no `stride` beyond the packed-array default of four.
- Object template: OBTE is a combination count, OBTF and STOP are empty markers and each OBTS combination is variable-length (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:5520-5529`; Fallout4.esm NPC_ OBTS payloads run from 18 to 186 bytes), so the object template gets no scalar rows in this change and OBTE stays unrowed like CS2H.
- Fixture master table: `Radicle/tests/test_npc_furn_attach_slots.cpp` declares Fallout4.esm and Objects.esp, so Patch.esp is master index 2, its own locals encode as 0x02xxxxxx and a raw index 0 is Fallout4.esm. The existing APPR payload on NPC_ 0x801 therefore points at 0x02000A30 and 0x02000A31, the KYWD records the plugin itself defines, while the CS2K and CS2D payloads on NPC_ 0x802 keep the raw index 0 values and are asserted unchanged alongside the rewritten index 1 and index 0, which makes the retarget per index provable. `payloads_of` takes an index for that reason, because CS2K and CS2D each repeat twice.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_npc_furn_attach_slots.cpp` (`NpcFurnAttachSlots`) checks both list descriptors (packed_array, APPR, non-nullable, insertable, KYWD allowed and SNDR refused), the two link descriptors and the CS2F row, an insert into an absent APPR list that lands after the last declared predecessor for NPC_ (`EDID,KWDA,APPR,DATA`) and after XMRK for FURN (`EDID,XMRK,APPR`) with the raw 0x02-prefixed id of a target inside the plugin itself, a save-and-reparse that preserves the packed payloads, an index past the last element reporting `index_out_of_range`, a SNDR target reporting `target_type_mismatch`, a removal that leaves one element, a second NPC_ record whose existing APPR list is read by value and retargeted, and the sound pair read and rewritten by index with the CS2F byte, plus a KYWD write to a CS2D slot throwing and an index past the last sound reporting `subrecord_missing`.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_perk_rows.cpp` (`PerkRows`) covers the absence of DATA scalar rows, the ICON/FNAM strings, SNAM/NNAM writes with a target-type refusal and a reread, the six generated authoring rules and the header DATA default bytes, `create_record` for PERK, a PASSING `Radicle/src/schema/preflight.cpp:preflight_authoring_record` on the fixture perk whose effect DATA follows FNAM (the same record fails on the nine-rule list, with `subrecord_order_invalid` and `subrecord_cardinality_invalid`), and a `required_subrecord_missing` refusal for a perk that has no DATA at all.

## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:INFO\Response (#602 B-21)

- Scope: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:INFO\Response` is a count-less subrecord group (no `count_subrecord`), one run per response, in xEdit's member order: TRDA 20 bytes required, NAM1, NAM2, NAM3 and NAM4 required variable-length, then the optional SNAM, LNAM, TNAM, NAM9, SRAF and WZMD. It reuses the count-less path added for `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\Markers`, so `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:insert_record_subrecord_group` appends a run at `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:first_successor_index` and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:remove_record_subrecord_group` deletes one run, both reporting `Radicle/include/fo4/plugin/mutation.hpp:SubrecordGroupMutationStatus`.
- xEdit: `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:9730` (`wbRArray('Responses', wbRStruct('Response', [...])`) with the members at `:9731-9750`; the successors are the condition run and the fields that follow it, `:9751-9766`.
- Variable-length members: `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:SubrecordGroupMemberDescriptor` gained `localized`, and `payload_size` 0 now means "no size check" instead of a zero-length payload, so NAM2, NAM3, NAM4, NAM9 and WZMD accept any payload and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:group_spans` only enforces the declared size when it is non-zero. NAM1 carries `localized: true`, which is what makes `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:insert_record_subrecord_group` refuse a plugin whose TES4 localized flag is set instead of writing a raw string where the game expects an lstring id.
- Generator: `Radicle/tools/schema_codegen.py:parse_subrecord_group` accepts `payload_size` 0 and an optional boolean `localized`, `Radicle/tools/schema_codegen.py:parse_group_default` skips its exact-length check for a variable member, and `Radicle/tools/subrecord_group_render.py:render_subrecord_groups` always emits the span and the localized flag in that order. `Radicle/tools/test_field_address_codegen.py` covers the new text and the zero-payload rejection message.
- Defaults: the required NAM1 to NAM4 members carry the one-byte default `00`, so an inserted response starts as an empty string, and `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:insert_record_subrecord_group` uses `default_payload` verbatim instead of padding it to `payload_size`; TRDA has no default and is inserted as 20 zero bytes.
- Localized refusal: a group with a localized member cannot be inserted into a plugin whose TES4 flag is set, because the inserted text would be a raw string where the game expects an lstring id. `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer_containers.cpp:insert_record_subrecord_group` throws `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:SubrecordGroupError` before it touches the record, so the bytes are unchanged. Reading, and inserting into a non-localized plugin, are unaffected; the flag is only read there, so no other path changes.
- Rows alongside the group: `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:INFO\IdleInterruptPercentage` rows the whole 2-byte TNAM payload as a u16, and `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:INFO\IdleSpeakerAnimation` (SNAM), `INFO\IdleListenerAnimation` (LNAM) and `INFO\CameraPath` (SRAF) row the three form ID members, `repeated` and `existing_only`, the same overlap of group members with their own rows that `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:FURN\MarkerIndex` uses. TNAM stays resolvable only by record plus path, so `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/scalar.hpp:scalar_field_descriptor(Signature, std::string_view)` is the lookup to use.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_dialogue_writer.cpp` (`DialogueWriter`) covers the descriptor shape and member order, appending an empty response before the condition run and editing its response number through `Radicle/src/plugin/field_writer.cpp:set_record_scalar`, inserting at the front and removing it again with the remaining pairs byte-identical, removing a response that carries the optional idle members and checking they go with it while the condition run stays, and the two negative cases: a localized plugin refuses the insert and leaves the file byte-identical, and an index past the last run reports `index_out_of_range` with no bytes changed.
## Radicle/src/forms/perk.cpp:read_perk_effects (#602 C-10, C-11)

- Effect sections for `wbRecord(PERK, 'Perk'` (`source:xEdit Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:7582-7691 @93cc0bc5`). `read_perk_effects` walks the trailing effect block from the first PRKE and returns one `PerkEffectEntry` per effect; `set_perk_effects` re-encodes the absolute list and replaces the same trailing block, so a perk with no PRKE gets its effects appended after the header (that is the whole create path, `create_record` having already written EDID and the header DATA). The block is trailing because xEdit lists Effects last in the record, after FNAM; a non-effect subrecord inside it throws, the same rule as `Radicle/src/forms/effects.cpp:decode_effects` for EFID blocks.
- `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/perk.hpp:PerkEffectEntry` keys the effect DATA on the PRKE type byte: type 0 is a QUST form ID plus a u16 stage (six bytes), type 1 a SPEL form ID (four bytes) and type 2 the entry point, function and condition tab count (three bytes); each arm fails closed on any other payload size, and a type above 2 throws. That is `wbPerkDATADecider` choosing among the three arms of `wbUnion(DATA, 'Effect Data', ...)` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:1411-1428`, arms at `:7613-7646`).
- `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/perk.hpp:PerkConditionTab` is one PRKC byte (Run On tab index, signed) followed by its contiguous CTDA run, read through `read_ctda_conditions_in`, which is why a tab takes its own range rather than one record-wide condition list. `PRKF` is required and must be the last subrecord of its effect, matching `wbEmpty(PRKF, 'End Marker', cpIgnore).SetRequired` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:7689`).
- `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/perk.hpp:PerkFunctionParameters` keeps the EPFT, EPFB, EPF2, EPF3 and EPFD members as independent optionals because the xEdit group marks none of them required (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:7653-7686`), so a reader that demanded all five would fail on a perk that carries only EPFT and EPFD. EPF2 goes through `Radicle/src/schema/localized_fields.cpp:read_localized_string`, so the button label round-trips in the form the file used (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:7662`); that table keys EPF2 for PERK unconditionally, whatever EPFT holds.
- EPFD stays verbatim bytes plus the arm index that `Radicle/src/forms/perk.cpp:epfd_decider` derives from EPFT, with EPFT 2 remapped to the actor-value arm 8 for the entry-point functions 5, 12, 13 and 14; that is `wbEPFDDecider` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:1430-1447`). `perk_epfd_float`, `perk_epfd_float_pair`, `perk_epfd_form`, `perk_epfd_text` and `perk_epfd_actor_value` decode the float, float-pair, LVLI/SPEL, text and AVIF-plus-multiplier arms and return `std::nullopt` for every other arm, so an edit that only changes EPFT cannot silently reinterpret the payload. Arm 7 (localized text) is decoded as raw bytes: EPFD is not in `Radicle/include/fo4/schema/generated_lstring_fields.inc`, and the reader must not guess between an inline string and a four-byte string ID.
- The arm sizes follow the xEdit declarations: arm 1 one float, arm 2 two floats, arms 3, 4 and 5 one four-byte form ID, arm 6 a NUL-terminated string, arm 8 an AVIF form ID plus a float (FO4 `wbActorValue` is `wbFormIDCkNoReach('Actor Value', [AVIF, NULL])`, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:3288`). The remap table already agrees with these: `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_mixed.cpp:perk_formid_offsets` rewrites EPFD +0 for arms 3, 4, 5 and for arm 8.
- `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/perk.hpp:PerkEffectEntry.condition_tab_count` is the raw entry-point DATA byte, not derived from `tabs`. xEdit treats it as a stored value (`wbInteger('Perk Condition Tab Count', itU8, nil, cpIgnore)`, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:7640`), so a caller that adds a tab must raise it explicitly.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_perk_rows.cpp` (`PerkEffects`) decodes an entry-point effect with one tab and a float EPFD, quest, ability and actor-value effects, the float-pair and text arms, a save-and-reparse that keeps all twelve subrecords in order and the SPEL word of an EPF2/EPF3 effect, an edit plus an added ability effect plus a removal of the whole block that leaves only EDID and the header DATA, `unsupported_record` and `record_missing` results, and six malformed payloads (short PRKE, effect type 3, missing PRKF, a three-byte quest DATA, a parameter group placed before the condition tabs, which `Radicle/src/forms/perk.cpp:decode_effect` refuses because xEdit reads PRKC runs before the parameter group, and an FNAM inside the block) that must throw.

## Radicle/src/forms/omod.cpp:read_omod_data (#602 B-54)

- The OMOD DATA arrays behind the reference tables. `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/omod.hpp:OmodData` carries the header bytes (Unknown Bool 1 and 2, Form Type, Max Rank, Level Tier Scaled Offset, Attach Point), the Attach Parent Slot list, the Items rows, the Includes rows and the Properties rows, and `Radicle/src/forms/omod.cpp:write_omod_data` writes the payload back into the record's DATA subrecord. Layout and sizes come from `source:xEdit Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:12510-12537` (the DATA struct) and `:5458-5516` (`wbObjectModProperties`), the same walk `Radicle/src/schema/form_link_mixed.cpp:omod_data_layout_offsets` uses for the remap: header to Attach Point at 16, a u32 count and 4-byte KYWD slots, a u32 count and 8-byte Item rows, 7-byte Include rows (OMOD form ID, Minimum Level, Optional, Don't Use All) and 24-byte Property rows.
- Include Count and Property Count are read as the array counts that define the walk and are not exposed as editable fields; the writer always derives them from `OmodData.includes` and `OmodData.properties`, so a payload whose stored count disagrees with its own rows cannot be produced. Decode fails closed instead: an array count that runs past the payload, a payload shorter than the 20-byte header, or a property count that does not consume the remaining bytes exactly all throw `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/omod.hpp:OmodError`. The two counts stay separately writable through their `Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:OMOD` scalar rows, which remain the only way to reach them (`Radicle/src/schema/form_link_mixed.cpp:omod_data_layout_offsets` then derives every later offset from that value, as the OMOD section above records).
- `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/omod.hpp:OmodItem` keeps both 4-byte Values verbatim: xEdit declares them as opaque byte arrays with the comment that the CK offers no way to change them (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:12529-12532`), so there is nothing to decode and nothing to remap.
- `Radicle/include/fo4/forms/omod.hpp:OmodProperty` keeps the 4-byte Values verbatim too and decodes them through the accessors, because the arm is chosen by the Value Type byte at row +0 (`wbOMODDataPropertyValue1Decider`, `Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:2382-2406`; arms declared at `:5474-5503`). `omod_property_value1_form` answers for Value Type 4 and 6 (the two arms the remap already rewrites at row +12), `omod_property_value1_float` for 1 only (Value Type 6 holds a form ID in Value 1 and a float in Value 2 only), `omod_property_value1_int` for 0, 2, 4 and 5 (Int, Bool, the word of a form-ID pair and Enum), `omod_property_value2_float` for 1 and 6 and `omod_property_value2_int` for 0, 2 and 4; every other combination returns `std::nullopt`, so an edit that changes Value Type cannot silently reinterpret the stored word. Value 2 is never a form ID (`wbOMODDataPropertyValue2Decider`, `:2408-2432`). Value Type 3 (String) is not decoded: its rows still hold a four-byte word the definition calls a string.
- Attach Point is a nullable KYWD at DATA +16 and each Attach Parent Slot is a nullable KYWD, so both decode to `FormKey{}` for a null word (`Radicle/src/formid.cpp:resolve_plugin_form_id` returns an empty key for a null raw word) and re-encode to raw 0, which keeps the array lengths unchanged.
- Tests: `Radicle/tests/test_omod_rows.cpp` (`OmodData`) decodes the fixture payload's header, one slot, one item with its two little-endian words, one include and no properties; decodes a Value Type 4 row through the form and integer arms and a Value Type 1 row to 1.0 and 2.0 with the form, integer and float arms that must decline; rewrites an untouched payload and asserts the DATA bytes equal the fixture byte for byte while MNAM is left alone; adds a slot, clears the items, duplicates an include and adds a Value Type 6 property, then asserts the derived counts are 2 and 1, the payload length is 74 and the reread row resolves its form word, declines Value 1 as a float and reads its 1.0 multiplier; and refuses a 16-byte payload, a payload with four extra trailing bytes, a payload cut to 24 bytes, a property count of 2 with no rows, an item count of 9, a missing record, a KYWD record and a freshly created OMOD whose authoring writes no DATA.
## Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:LENS\FadeDistanceRadiusScale, Radicle/src/schema/behavior_layout.cpp:behavior_field_candidates (#602 B-31)

- Radicle/schema/fallout4/fields.json:LENS\FadeDistanceRadiusScale adds `wbFloat(DNAM, 'Fade Distance Radius Scale')` (`Core/wbDefinitionsFO4.pas:12408`) as a whole-payload f32 `existing_only` row on DNAM, the same shape as `LENS\ColorInfluence` on CNAM. xEdit attaches no default to it: `.SetDefaultEditValue('1.0')` is an editor display value, not stored bytes, so authoring gains no default and `LENS.authoring.subrecords` already lists DNAM.
- The row needed a scope first. The sprite array reuses DNAM for the sprite ID string (`:12412`), and the earlier Radicle/docs/code-notes/Radicle.md LENS entry records that the top-level DNAM is absent in 21 of the 49 corpus records, so in those the first DNAM is a sprite string. `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` collects every subrecord whose signature matches and refuses with `duplicate` when `address.repeated` is false, and `Radicle/src/schema/scalar.cpp:scalar_field_bytes` throws on a whole-payload row whose payload is not four bytes, so a plain row would either refuse or decode text as a float.
- Radicle/src/schema/behavior_layout.cpp:behavior_field_candidates therefore gains a LENS branch: for `DNAM` it returns only the DNAM subrecords that precede the first LFSP. `Radicle/src/schema/field_address.cpp:resolve_field_slots` already consults that function before its duplicate check, so the row addresses the record-level DNAM, and a record whose only DNAM subrecords follow LFSP reports `subrecord_missing` instead of picking a sprite string. An LFSP-less record takes the same path with no boundary, which is the record-level case.
- Radicle/src/schema/behavior_layout.cpp:behavior_formid_offsets reaches `behavior_field_candidates` only for PACK, after its `record_type != "PACK"` early return, so the LENS branch changes no remap offsets. No other caller passes a LENS record.
- Not covered, unchanged: the sprite array itself (DNAM string, FNAM string, LFSD struct, `:12410-12426`) and the LFSP count (`:12409`). LFSP stays out of authoring because the sprite DNAM follows it in vanilla and `Radicle/src/schema/preflight.cpp:preflight_authoring_record` would reject that order.
- Radicle/tests/test_material_impact_records.cpp:MaterialImpactSynthetic.LensFadeScaleUsesTheDnamBeforeTheSpriteList builds a LENS with a 4-byte record DNAM, `LFSP` 2 and two sprite DNAM strings, writes 2.5 through the row and asserts the reread record still has three DNAM subrecords with the two sprite strings byte-identical. Radicle/tests/test_material_impact_records.cpp:MaterialImpactSynthetic.LensFadeScaleIsMissingWithoutARecordLevelDnam is the negative case: a LENS whose only DNAM follows LFSP refuses the write with `subrecord_missing` and leaves the sprite string untouched.
- Radicle/tests/test_material_impact_records_real.cpp:EveryBatchRecordMatchesItsAuthoringAndDecodesEveryRow now asks `behavior_field_candidates` for the scoped indices before decoding a matching subrecord, because the old loop assumed every subrecord sharing a row's signature is addressed by that row, which the LENS sprite DNAM contradicts. The real-data check still decodes every subrecord the row actually addresses.
- Parity: `Radicle/tools/parity_matrix.py:main` regenerated `Radicle/docs/FO4_PARITY.md`; LENS moves from 1 to 2 scalar rows.
